x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: versionbumper - Increments version numbers in .NET solution projects.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: The workspace path containing the solution file and version_definition.json.

options.name: --add-version-props
options.description: Add version properties (ReleaseVersion, AssemblyVersion, FileVersion, Version) to project files that do not already have them. Test projects are excluded.

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: Include test projects when bumping versions and when initializing version properties with --add-version-props.
